phase: Canonical per-product API normalization pipeline implemented
objective: Parse and verify every available WoW API for each supported product, then generate Basic, Modern, and Advanced real-world examples.

source_roles.Baneto Source Code: example complexity/style inspiration ONLY; never API authority

hard_rules: An API may be used in an example only if verified for the target product/build.
Baneto source must never establish API availability.
Unknown or unverified APIs must not be silently substituted or included.
Global Functions documentation does not imply availability in every expansion.
Examples may combine multiple verified WoW APIs.
Examples should be standalone functions where practical.
Examples target practical addon/bot automation use.
Raw source records must remain distinguishable from canonical API records.
Descriptions must never be invented when the authoritative harvested data has no description.
canonical_pipeline: Normalize product variants into Retail, Classic, Classic Era, and Classic Anniversary.
Retain source variants and branch evidence.
Prefer documented signatures over source-discovered records.
Emit canonical_api_database.json and one product JSON per supported product.
Validate uniqueness, variants, availability metadata, and product coverage.
next_tasks: Integrate canonical builder and validator into the Workbench UI.
Import Ketho branch data and attach availability evidence.
Add API documentation enrichment from authoritative sources.
Implement dependency-aware Basic, Practical, and Advanced Lua example generation.
Add search and API detail views to the Windows UI.
Package the final Workbench as a Windows application.
